title: Cover me cover me

lines.text: Extend the border of Thy mantle over me,
Because Thou art my nearest kinsman
Cover me, cover me, cover me.
My daughter I will do to thee
Because thou art a virtuous woman

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cover me, cover me
Extend the border of Thy mantle over me,
Because Thou art my nearest kinsman
Cover me, cover me, cover me.

[Verse 2]
Fear not, fear not
My daughter I will do to thee
All you need,
Because thou art a virtuous woman
Fear not, fear not.
